messages.subject: Issue with Request$POST()
parts:
Hi all,

I'm running into a strange issue with Rook/rApache in what I would have thought to be a well-trodden code path. Essentially, my app attempts to call the POST() method of a request object. The request (submitted with curl, in this case) is coming through application/x-www-form-urlencoded, which, in turn, causes it to be passed to Multipart$parse(), which calls rewind() on the rApacheInputStream - but rApacheInputStream doesn't support rewind, so I can't get access to the POST data. Code to reproduce what I'm seeing is below.

I'm able to work around this temporarily by using the superglobal POST, but this doesn't seem like a good idea generally.

- Evan


$ curl -d 'data=somedata' http://127.0.0.1:8080/myapp

yields
{
 "warning": "rApache doesn't support rewind()",
"NA": [
 [
 "$",
"input",
"rewind" 
] 
] 
}


The code (myapp) looks like this:
library(Rook)
library(RJSONIO)

app <- function(env) {

    req <- Rook::Request$new(env)
    res <- Rook::Response$new()

    tryCatch (

      if (req$post()){
          data <- req$POST()[["data"]]
          res$write(data)
      },
      error = function(cond) {
        message <- c(cond)
        names(message) <- c("error")
        res$write(toJSON(message))
      },
      warning = function(cond) {
        message <- c(cond)
        names(message) <- c("warning")
        res$write(toJSON(message))
      }
    )
    res$finish()
}
